items.name: Whispers Vinery
items.note: Voted on together with the new Vazon local centre, drawing the most votes against of any site. The inspector recommended against both. The DPA's own amendment to cap the site at 40 homes, against an assessed capacity of 53, was lost by 24 votes to 6.

items.name: Two Acres
items.note: An amendment to cap the site at 15 homes was lost by 23 votes to 6. Permission to change 4,114 sqm of agricultural land at Two Acres to garden and demolish the glasshouses was granted on 25 November.

apps.d: Change of use of agricultural land to domestic garden.
Change of use of agricultural land to domestic garden (4,114sqm), demolish glasshouses and outbuildings and associated works.

items.addr: Rue des Caches, St Pierre du Bois

apps.d: Change of use of agricultural land to domestic curtilage (2,300sqm); remove hedging, erect polytunnel, fruit cages, fencing and compost bins (revised scheme).

Change of use of agricultural land (Use Class 28) to camp site, including installation of 9 glamping units with associated landscaping and parking, create vehicular access to north boundary, extend and alter barn 'A' (northern barn) to provide facilities block, including the provision of wellbeing activities, and use of area of domestic curtilage for the provision of outdoor wellbeing activities (Protected Building).
